# deceived

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:roleDeceived`](gmeow-roleDeceived.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/roleDeceived>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

The participant in a deception event who is induced to hold a false belief by the divergence between the projected and held standpoints. In self-deception, this role is borne by the same entity as [`roleDeceiver`](gmeow-roleDeceiver.md).
